subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is coming up on Friday, September 24th. This year, we have planned a fun-filled day with team-building activities, games, and a delicious catered lunch. We appreciate all your hard work and dedication, and this event is our way of saying thank you. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details! Best regards, HR Team
